points.title: 早年成长与教育
points.description: 马基雅维利出生于佛罗伦萨一个没落的贵族家庭。尽管家境并不富裕，但他的父亲仍为他提供了良好的古典教育。马基雅维利学习了拉丁语和意大利语，深入研读了古罗马历史和文学，特别是李维的《罗马史》和西塞罗的作品。这段时期的学习为他后来的政治思想奠定了坚实基础。佛罗伦萨的人文主义氛围也深刻影响了他，使他形成了对古典政治智慧的独特理解。
points.descriptionEn: Machiavelli was born in Florence to a declining noble family. Despite modest circumstances, his father provided him with a solid classical education. Machiavelli studied Latin and Italian, delving deeply into Roman history and literature, particularly Livy's 'History of Rome' and Cicero's works. This period of study laid the foundation for his later political thought. The humanist atmosphere of Florence profoundly influenced him, shaping his unique understanding of classical political wisdom.

points.title: 政治生涯与外交活动
points.description: 1494年，美第奇家族被驱逐出佛罗伦萨，建立了共和国政府。马基雅维利开始在政府中任职，先后担任第二国务秘书和外交官。在此期间，他频繁出使欧洲各国，包括法国、德国和瑞士，积累了丰富的外交经验。他参与了多次重要外交谈判，试图在意大利各城邦和外国势力之间维持平衡。1512年，美第奇家族在西班牙支持下重返佛罗伦萨，共和国政府被推翻，马基雅维利被解职并短暂入狱。
points.descriptionEn: In 1494, the Medici family was expelled from Florence, establishing a republican government. Machiavelli began his government career, serving as second chancellor and diplomat. During this time, he frequently traveled to European countries including France, Germany, and Switzerland, accumulating extensive diplomatic experience. He participated in numerous important diplomatic negotiations, attempting to maintain balance among Italian city-states and foreign powers. In 1512, with Spanish support, the Medici family returned to power, the republican government was overthrown, and Machiavelli was dismissed and briefly imprisoned.

points.title: 流放与著作创作
points.description: 被解职后，马基雅维利被流放到佛罗伦萨周边的乡村。这段时期是他创作的黄金时代。他开始撰写政治学著作，包括《君主论》(1513年完成)和《论李维》(1517年完成)。在《君主论》中，他提出了著名的政治现实主义观点，认为君主为了维持权力可以采取任何必要的手段，包括欺骗和暴力。这一时期，他还创作了喜剧《曼陀罗花》和历史著作《佛罗伦萨史》。尽管被流放，马基雅维利仍密切关注政治动态，并试图通过献书给美第奇家族来重新获得政治职位。
points.descriptionEn: After being dismissed, Machiavelli was exiled to the countryside surrounding Florence. This period became his golden age of creation. He began writing political works, including 'The Prince' (completed in 1513) and 'Discourses on Livy' (completed in 1517). In 'The Prince', he presented his famous political realist views, arguing that a ruler can take any necessary measures to maintain power, including deception and violence. During this time, he also wrote the comedy 'Mandragola' and the historical work 'History of Florence'. Despite his exile, Machiaveli closely followed political developments and attempted to regain a political position by dedicating his works to the Medici family.

points.title: 重返政坛与晚年
points.titleEn: Return to Politics and Later Years
points.description: 1520年，马基雅维利被美第奇家族重新召回佛罗伦萨，负责军事事务。他被任命为佛罗伦萨城防委员会的秘书，负责组织和防御工作。1527年，美第奇家族再次被推翻，共和国政府恢复，但马基雅维利未能重新获得重要职位，这让他深感失望。同年，他在佛罗伦萨去世，享年58岁。尽管晚年政治失意，但他的政治思想已经形成，并对后世产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: In 1520, Machiavelli was recalled to Florence by the Medici family and put in charge of military affairs. He was appointed secretary of the Florentine fortifications committee, responsible for organizing and defense work. In 1527, the Medici family was overthrown again, the republican government was restored, but Machiavelli failed to regain an important position, which left him deeply disappointed. He died in Florence later that year at the age of 58. Despite his political disappointment in later years, his political thought had already taken shape and had a profound impact on later generations.

points.title: 政治思想的深远影响
points.description: 马基雅维利的政治思想对后世产生了深远影响。他的现实主义政治观打破了中世纪神权政治的束缚，开创了现代政治学的先河。'马基雅维利主义'成为政治术语，描述为达目的不择手段的政治行为。他的思想影响了霍布斯、卢梭等后来的政治哲学家，也启发了现代国际关系理论中的现实主义学派。尽管他的著作在出版初期遭到教会谴责，但后来被广泛研究，成为政治学、国际关系和战略思想的重要经典。
points.descriptionEn: Machiavelli's political thought had a profound impact on later generations. His realistic political view broke the shackles of medieval theocratic politics and pioneered modern political science. 'Machiavellianism' became a political term describing the use of any means to achieve political ends. His ideas influenced later political philosophers such as Hobbes and Rousseau, and also inspired the realist school in modern international relations theory. Although his works were condemned by the church after their initial publication, they were later widely studied and became important classics in political science, international relations, and strategic thought.

supporter.zh: 马基雅维利被视为现代政治科学的奠基人之一。他的现实主义政治观打破了中世纪神权政治的束缚，开创了政治研究的科学方法。支持者认为，他诚实地揭示了政治的本质，不回避权力运作的残酷现实，为后世政治理论提供了重要基础。他的著作《君主论》和《论李维》至今仍是政治学领域的经典，对理解权力、政治策略和国家治理具有不可替代的价值。
supporter.en: Machiavelli is regarded as one of the founders of modern political science. His realistic political view broke the shackles of medieval theocratic politics and pioneered a scientific approach to political study. Supporters argue that he honestly revealed the essence of politics, without flinching from the harsh realities of power dynamics, providing an important foundation for later political theory. His works 'The Prince' and 'Discourses on Livy' remain classics in political science, offering invaluable insights into power, political strategy, and governance.

critic.zh: 批评者认为马基雅维利的政治思想过于功利主义和道德相对主义，为独裁和暴政提供了理论依据。他的'为达目的不择手段'的观点被批评为忽视了道德在政治中的重要性。教会曾将他的著作列为禁书，指责他宣扬无神论和政治腐败。批评者认为，马基雅维利的政治现实主义可能导致政治犬儒主义，使人们放弃对理想政治的追求和对道德标准的坚守。
critic.en: Critics argue that Machiavelli's political thought is excessively utilitarian and morally relativistic, providing theoretical justification for dictatorship and tyranny. His 'end justifies the means' approach is criticized for neglecting the importance of morality in politics. The Church once banned his works, accusing him of promoting atheism and political corruption. Critics believe that Machiavelli's political realism can lead to political cynicism, causing people to abandon the pursuit of ideal politics and adherence to moral standards.

objective.zh: 从历史和流行文化视角看，马基雅维利被复杂地定义为一个既是政治现实主义者又是道德怀疑论者的矛盾人物。在学术界，他被公认为现代政治科学的先驱，其思想对国际关系理论、政治哲学和战略研究产生了深远影响。在流行文化中，'马基雅维利主义'一词常被用来形容狡诈、不择手段的政治行为，这反映了公众对其思想的简化理解。然而，近年来，学者们开始更全面地解读他的思想，认识到他并非简单地提倡不道德行为，而是试图在现实政治中寻找有效治理的可能路径。
objective.en: From historical and cultural perspectives, Machiavelli is complexly defined as a contradictory figure who was both a political realist and a moral skeptic. In academia, he is widely recognized as a pioneer of modern political science, with his thoughts having a profound impact on international relations theory, political philosophy, and strategic studies. In popular culture, the term 'Machiavellian' is often used to describe cunning and unscrupulous political behavior, reflecting a simplified public understanding of his ideas. In recent years, however, scholars have begun to interpret his thought more comprehensively, recognizing that he was not simply advocating immoral behavior but rather seeking possible paths for effective governance in real-world politics.

self.zh: 一个君主，特别是新君主，不能遵守那些被认为是好人应做的所有事情，因为他要保持国家，常常不得不背信弃义、不仁不义、没有人性。
self.en: A prince, especially a new one, cannot observe all those things for which men are esteemed good, because he is often obliged to maintain the state against his faith, against charity, against humanity, and against religion.

others.zh: 马基雅维利是政治学中的伽利略，他首次将政治从道德神学中解放出来，使其成为一门独立的科学。
others.en: Machiavelli is the Galileo of politics; he was the first to liberate politics from moral theology and make it an independent science.
